title: Owner decides thresholds and reminder times
goal: The resistance interval, storage reminder times and health limits are confirmed
acceptance: Proposed defaults in the design note confirmed or changed: resistance interval, first and later storage reminders, cell growth alert, retirement value per pack type
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-15: resistance check every 90 days or 30 cycles, whichever first; storage reminder 21:00 the same day, again 5 days later, then daily until stored; cell growth: warning at >= +50% over its first record or >= +30% over the pack median, strong warning at >= +100% or >= +50%; retirement for packs without a model profile: 6S LiPo any cell >= 12 mOhm, 3S LiHV >= 10 mOhm; a model profile wins over the type default: Tattu R-Line V6 1480 mAh 6S 160C healthy 0.8-3.5, aging warning >= 4.5, strong warning >= 7, retire >= 8 mOhm or spread > 30%, provisional until calibrated with the owner charger readings in F-008-T12. No actual: owner time not measured.
